Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the image rendered as a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: The image’s visual content is represented in a recognizable pencil-drawn style.
node.binding: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: the requested change is to render the source image as a pencil drawing.
node.source_quote: Change the image into pencil drawing
node.endpoint: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: No requested pencil-drawing change is visible; unrelated edits do not count.
node.half_when: About half of the image’s visual content has a concrete pencil-drawn treatment, while substantial content remains in its original non-pencil rendering.
node.full_when: The image’s visual content is rendered throughout in a recognizable pencil-drawing style, allowing natural variation in texture and lighting.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image preserves the source scene and renders it throughout in a recognizable pencil-drawing style, with muted graphite-like tones, sketchy outlines, and textured shading across the food, dishes, and background. No substantial area remains in the original photographic rendering.
